new.brief: Creates a new `GtkFontDialogButton` with the given `GtkFontDialog`.
new.md:
Creates a new `GtkFontDialogButton` with the
given `GtkFontDialog`.

You can pass `NULL` to this function and set a `GtkFontDialog`
later. The button will be insensitive until that happens.

doc.brief: Opens a font chooser dialog to select a font.
doc.md:
Opens a font chooser dialog to select a font.

It is suitable widget for selecting a font in a preference dialog.

# CSS nodes

```
fontbutton
╰── button.font
    ╰── [content]
```

`GtkFontDialogButton` has a single CSS node with name fontbutton which
contains a button node with the .font style class.

get_font_desc.brief: Returns the font of the button.
get_font_desc.md:
Returns the font of the button.

This function is what should be used to obtain
the font that was chosen by the user. To get
informed about changes, listen to "notify::font-desc".

get_font_features.brief: Returns the font features of the button.
get_font_features.md:
Returns the font features of the button.

This function is what should be used to obtain the font features
that were chosen by the user. To get informed about changes, listen
to "notify::font-features".

Note that the button will only let users choose font features
if [`FontDialogButton:level`](xref:gtk:Gtk.FontDialogButton#property:level) is set to
`GTK_FONT_LEVEL_FEATURES`.

get_use_size.md: Returns whether the selected font size is used in the label.

dialog.brief: The `GtkFontDialog` that contains parameters for the font chooser dialog.
dialog.md:
The `GtkFontDialog` that contains parameters for
the font chooser dialog.

font-desc.md:
The selected font.

This property can be set to give the button its initial
font, and it will be updated to reflect the users choice
in the font chooser dialog.

Listen to `notify::font-desc` to get informed about changes
to the buttons font.

font-features.md:
The selected font features.

This property will be updated to reflect the users choice
in the font chooser dialog.

Listen to `notify::font-features` to get informed about changes
to the buttons font features.

language.brief: The selected language for font features.
language.md:
The selected language for font features.

This property will be updated to reflect the users choice
in the font chooser dialog.

Listen to `notify::language` to get informed about changes
to the buttons language.

level.brief: The level of detail for the font chooser dialog.
level.md: The level of detail for the font chooser dialog.

use-font.brief: Whether the buttons label will be drawn in the selected font.
use-font.md: Whether the buttons label will be drawn in the selected font.

use-size.brief: Whether the buttons label will use the selected font size.
use-size.md: Whether the buttons label will use the selected font size.

activate.brief: Emitted when the font dialog button is activated.
activate.md:
Emitted when the font dialog button is activated.

The `::activate` signal on `GtkFontDialogButton` is an action signal
and emitting it causes the button to pop up its dialog.
